patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I've been throwing up and my stomach hurts, and I can't stop breathing heavy and fast. I'm so thirsty and I'm peeing constantly. I ran out of my insulin a few days ago.
presentation.triageNote: 19-year-old female with type 1 diabetes who ran out of insulin several days ago. She has vomiting, abdominal pain, intense thirst, frequent urination, dehydration, fruity breath, and deep rapid respirations at 32/min.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because deep rapid respirations, dehydration, vomiting, and missed insulin indicate a high-risk metabolic emergency.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient with type 1 diabetes has several days without insulin, gastrointestinal symptoms, polyuria, polydipsia, fruity breath, tachycardia, and Kussmaul-pattern breathing.
clinical.acuityReason: Severe metabolic derangement and dehydration can deteriorate rapidly and require prompt monitored treatment, although current perfusion and oxygenation are maintained.
expectedResources: Immediate bedside glucose and blood gas
keyFindings: Type 1 diabetes without insulin for several days
teachingPoints: Deep rapid breathing in this setting is respiratory compensation, not primarily a lung disorder.
Potassium must be assessed and monitored closely during insulin treatment.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Monitored fluids, electrolyte management, and insulin would be followed by admission until the acidosis resolves and a safe insulin plan is restored.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 19-year-old woman, exhausted and dehydrated, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped, chest rising with deep fast breaths. Expression: worn out with dry, cracked lips. Clearly visible: deep labored breathing and a drained, dehydrated look. No text, no logos.
